up: Retrieve IC50 bioactivity data against target CHEMBL3879801 for the parent compound tylophorine (CHEMBL493620) and all of its salt forms (identified via the molecule_hierarchy table). For each qualifying activity, return the molecule ChEMBL ID, the molecule preferred name, the canonical SMILES, the standard IC50 value with its units, the PubMed ID or DOI, and the assay description.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
  SELECT parent.molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'
  UNION
  SELECT child.molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description
FROM compound_set
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = compound_set.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
WHERE ass.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3879801')
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
